{
  "voice": "lynch",
  "seat_kind": "challenge",
  "nominations": [],
  "declared": {
    "data_source": "fundamentals_pack.json inlined, no mid-run fetch",
    "coverage_note": "all 20 deliberation-set names served; per-ticker caveats honored as noted in the pack",
    "currency_flags": ["DB reports in EUR", "UMC reports in TWD — do not mix market_cap/revenue with USD peers"],
    "canon_standing": {
      "math_library": "PARTIALLY_COMPUTABLE — C8 (PEG), C12 (equity ratio), C13 (FCF yield) testable; C10/C11 (net cash floor, effective P/E) NOT_COMPUTABLE.",
      "category": "NOT_SERVED — no lynch_category field; category reads are PROVISIONAL.",
      "fail_gates": "NOT_TESTABLE — Gate 1 (debt KIND) absent, Gate 2 (inventory vs sales) absent, Gate 3 half-testable.",
      "two_minute_drill": "NOT_POSSIBLE (C3) — no business description in the pack; every verdict is a RATIO verdict.",
      "peg_methodology_caveat": "Negative PEG means declining earnings, NOT a bargain. 7 names negative trailing PEG (CNH, DE, LNG, KHC, SLB, CTVA, BOX), 5 negative forward PEG (KHC, EQT, CVX, UMC, PBR).",
      "stop_position": "DEFERRED_TO_HOUSE_LAW (C21) — no position on any bracket/stop/risk gate."
    }
  },
  "fundamentals_judgment": [full 20-ticker array committed verbatim to lynch.json at this same run — see that file for complete verdict/rationale/key_fields_cited/red_flags per ticker: WELL GARP_FAIL, CNH QUALITY_CONCERN, DE GARP_FAIL, AAPL GARP_FAIL, LNG QUALITY_CONCERN, DB VALUE_TRAP_RISK, CVS GARP_FAIL, GEN QUALITY_CONCERN, KHC NOT_MEANINGFUL, SLB GARP_PASS, EQT VALUE_TRAP_RISK, CTVA GARP_FAIL, ADM GARP_FAIL, CVX GARP_PASS, BOX GARP_FAIL, KVYO NOT_MEANINGFUL, T QUALITY_CONCERN, UMC QUALITY_CONCERN, OKE QUALITY_CONCERN, PBR VALUE_TRAP_RISK],
  "asks": [full 12-item list committed verbatim to lynch.json at this same run — lynch_category field, earnings growth rate, cash/net-cash-per-share, inventory/revenue quarters, debt KIND split, institutional ownership, payout ratio, sector-relative P/E, USD-normalized figures for DB/UMC, captive-finance segmentation, REIT FFO/AFFO, process ask],
  "no_challenge_reason": null
}
